description: This Java class 'ImageCache' manages bitmap caching (memory cache using LruCache) for an Android application, including methods for cache initialization, adding, retrieving bitmaps, and retaining cache instance across configuration changes via a retained Fragment.

classes.name: ImageCache
classes.description: Manages in-memory bitmap cache with LruCache, provides methods to add and retrieve bitmaps, and retains cache instance across configuration changes.

classes.name: ImageCache.RetainFragment
classes.description: A non-UI Fragment used to retain the ImageCache object across configuration changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton ImageCache instance associated with a FragmentManager, using a specified cache size percentage.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the memory cache with a size based on a percentage of available app memory.

methods.name: addBitmapToCache
methods.description: Adds a bitmap to the memory cache with a unique string key.

methods.name: getBitmapFromMemCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from the memory cache by its key.

methods.name: getBitmapSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a bitmap, using getByteCount() if available.

methods.name: calculateMemCacheSize
methods.description: Calculates cache size in kilobytes based on a percentage of max runtime memory, with bounds checking.

methods.name: findOrCreateRetainFragment
methods.description: Finds an existing RetainFragment by tag or creates and adds a new one to the FragmentManager.
